Back from the 2026 Guelph Annual Underwater Hockey Tournament with a fantastic reward in hand!

The **CAMOtarie** team proudly defended the club's colors throughout the weekend. Despite a few twists and turns and a smaller roster than usual, the squad demonstrated remarkable resilience to climb all the way to the final and capture the **silver medal in B Division**.

<figure class="my-6">
  <img src="/competitions/guelph-2026/653709478_1568021515026552_9050410899644543456_n.jpg" alt="CAMOtarie team in the pool at Guelph" class="rounded-lg shadow max-w-full h-auto mx-auto">
  <figcaption class="text-sm text-gray-500 text-center mt-2">The CAMOtarie team in the pool during the 44th annual Guelph tournament.</figcaption>
</figure>

### CAMOtarie Team

* Antoine Andrade
* Cristian Mendez
* David Gagné
* Martin Chevrier
* Philippe Vinet
* Ricky Ng-Adam
* Stéphanie Lagacé
* Valérie Robert

A huge congratulations to the entire team for the underwater intensity, team spirit, and usual great energy. Special thanks also to the University of Guelph organizers for this successful 44th edition!
